findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: reverse · Private data: plans, plan_claim, model_record, follow, follows, unfollow, strategies, price, strategy_quote, vault_prepare, replay_record · Public sink: draw, film · Destructive: strategies, reverse, studio_move, erase.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: reverse · Private data: plans, plan_claim, model_record, follow, follows, unfollow, strategies, price, strategy_quote, vault_prepare, replay_record · Public sink: draw, film · Destructive: strategies, reverse, studio_move, erase

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "vault_prepare" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The wallet steps for a Cubicle vault as UNSIGNED transactions and EIP-712 typed data for the owner's own wallet. Open: call without vault for the transaction that opens it. Fund and hire: call again with the new vault's address (from my_vaults) for allow + deposit and the mandate to sign. Withdraw: " → after: "The wallet steps for a Cubicle vault as UNSIGNED transactions and EIP-712 typed data for the owner's own wallet. Open: call without vault for the transaction that opens it. Fund and hire: call again with the new vault's address (from my_vaults) for allow + deposit and the mandate to sign. Withdraw: "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
